# Vectree

> Vectree is a platform providing information on Dominican street food culture, recipes, and legal documentation.

The site focuses on food culture education, particularly Dominican cuisine and traditional dishes like Yaroa. It also maintains standard platform governance through terms of service and privacy policies.

## Key Topics

- Yaroa
- Dominican cuisine
- Street food
- Recipe components
- Food culture
- Layered dishes
- Privacy policy
- Data collection
- Terms of service
- User agreement
- Content ownership
- Security

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy - Vectree](https://vectree.io/privacy): Privacy policy covering data collection, encryption, and GDPR compliance
- [Terms of Service - Vectree](https://vectree.io/terms): Legal terms of service and user agreement for Vectree platform

## Optional Resources

- [Yaroa](https://vectree.io/random): Dominican street food dish with layered components of plantains or fries
